spans.s: -sphoṭakam, adv. (cf. sphoṭā, ˚ṭika, and Skt. sphoṭa): na jihvā-˚kam (sc. paribhokṣyāmaḥ) Mvy 〔8586〕 (a śaikṣa rule), (we will) not (eat) making a smacking noise with the tongue.
Sphoṭana, n. of a nāga king: Mvy 〔3277〕; Māy 〔246.26〕.
Sphoṭanī, n. of a rākṣasī: Māy 〔243.23〕.
sphoṭā (in this mg. Skt. sphoṭana, pw), snap of the fingers: mahā-sphoṭā-saṃghāta-śabdena SP 〔388.9〕 (prose), referring to, and synonymous with, acchaṭā-saṃghātaśabda, just before, see acchaṭā.
sphoṭika, Mv 〔iii.58.4〕, uncertain mg., see s.v. tripuṣkara.
